oneChannel: WebP has no greyscale mode: the one-channel maps decode as RGB with R = G = B; read R
projection: equirectangular (plate carree): u = (lon + 180) / 360, v = (90 - lat) / 180; Greenwich at u = 0.5

day_8k.webp.source: Blue Marble Next Generation, December 2004, with topography and bathymetry

night_4k.webp.source: Black Marble 2016 (greyscale), Suomi NPP VIIRS day/night band composite

clouds_2k.webp.source: Blue Marble (2002) combined cloud map; NASA serves only 2048 x 1024 now

relief_4k.webp.channels: one: 0..127 ocean (127 shoreline, darker deeper), 128..255 land (128 sea level, brighter higher); NASA's greyscales, not metres
relief_4k.webp.source: GEBCO_08 elevation and bathymetry greyscales from Blue Marble Next Generation

mask_4k.webp.channels: one: 255 land (incl. ice sheets and lakes below the bathymetry's reach), 0 ocean; lossless

credit: NASA Earth Observatory: Blue Marble Next Generation (Reto Stockli, NASA Goddard); Black Marble 2016 (Joshua Stevens, Miguel Roman, NASA GSFC, Suomi NPP); Blue Marble clouds (2002); GEBCO_08 Grid (General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans) via NASA
terms: NASA imagery: public domain, credit NASA; GEBCO grid: public domain with acknowledgement
